routeHint: Sidebar -> Courses. Requires the Courses module active (Settings -> Gamification & Courses -> Courses -> Enable Courses).
alt: Courses list showing course cards with lesson, quiz and student counts, an All Courses and My Courses tab, and a Create a course button

routeHint: Courses -> hover a course card -> Lessons. Or open the course, click Edit, then the Lessons tab. Sign in as a user with HR_TENANT so the tab is enabled. Pick a course that already has 2+ sections with a mix of lessons and quizzes.
alt: Course builder Lessons tab showing sections with nested lessons and quizzes, drag handles, per-item Draft and Published tags, and an Add new menu

routeHint: Courses -> hover a course card -> Students. Or open the course, click Edit, then the Students tab. Needs HR_TENANT and a course with enrolments so the table is not empty.
alt: Students tab of a course showing the status filter, student count, Export menu and a table with member, enrolled date, last update, progress bar and status
